primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: The HAMD-17 consists of 8 items with a score on a 3 point scale and 9 items with a score on a 5 point scale. The total score ranging from 0 to 52 will be calculated as the sum of the scores for all 17 items. Higher total scores denote more severe depression.

groups.description: Pimavanserin 34 mg administered orally as a single dose once daily
groups.title: Pimavanserin

groups.description: Placebo tablets administered orally as a single dose once daily
groups.title: Placebo

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: Full Analysis Set: all subjects who were randomized, received at least one dose of study drug, and had a baseline value and at least one postbaseline value for HAMD-17 total score.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Change From Baseline to Week 5 in Hamilton Depression Scale (17 Items) (HAMD-17) Total Score
